column1: # Pinned container images of the catalog. One row per image, columns
#   name      repository name under the image registry
#   upstream  the upstream repository the image is copied from
#   tag       the upstream tag; the copy gets the same tag
#   digest    the upstream multi-arch index digest; `crane copy` keeps it,
#             so the copy has the same digest
#   apps      the app directories that use the image (comma separated)
#   track     how the weekly upstream check (scripts/upstream-check.py) finds
#             a newer image: chart = the appVersion of the app's mirror chart
#             (same prefix and suffix as tag); tags = the newest upstream tag
#             of the same shape as tag
